functionality.rationale: A formatting-only rewrite could accidentally alter a token in the accepted storage implementation.

security.rationale: The task preserves all storage security logic and permits no token-level change.

performance.rationale: Whitespace and line wrapping do not alter generated code or performance.

compatibility.rationale: Public and internal C++ tokens must remain identical while formatting is restored.

concurrency.rationale: The task changes no executable concurrency behavior.

platform.rationale: The restored project format must pass the cross-platform repository source gate.

persistence.rationale: The task changes no storage format, file operation, or persisted state.

adr.rationale: Restoring checked-in source formatting changes no architectural or product decision.

architecture.rationale: No runtime module, target, dependency, or ownership boundary changes.

roadmap.rationale: The task restores an engineering gate and does not deliver roadmap behavior.
